_comment: Ground-truth manifest for the end-to-end OCR pipeline tests.
Each entry points at a fixture image (or video) under tests/test_images/ and
declares what the scanner should detect. The pipeline crops to `scan_region`
(mimicking in-game calibration), runs the real OCREngine + RSResolver, and the
test runs each fixture `runs` times requiring `min_pass_rate` to be the top match.
scan_region: [x, y, width, height] in pixels. If omitted, the whole image is used.
expected_top: {name, quantity} that must be the highest-confidence ore, or null
for negative cases (nothing should be detected).
To add your own captures: drop the file in backend/tests/test_images/ and add an
entry here. Videos (.mp4/.mov/...) are sampled every `stride` frames.

fixtures.note: RS 10,620 = 3 x Beryl (3540). Comma + location pin + particles present.
RS 7,080 = 2 x Beryl (3540). An UNKNOWN/18.8km marker sits outside the scan region and must not be detected.
No RS signature on screen -> nothing should resolve.
